mechanics.claim: The empowered basic attack's main-target hit does not apply life steal, while the cone deals separate area damage without applying spell effects (on-hit/on-attack effects).
mechanics.quote: The main target is dealt {{tip|basic damage}}, though without {{tip|applies lifesteal|applying life steal}}, while the cone deals {{tip|area damage|area}} non-{{tip|proc damage|proc}} damage without applying {{tip|spell effects}}.

mechanics.claim: Thunderclap's empowered attack resets Malphite's basic attack timer.
The cone does not deal its damage separately if the target has left the area of effect when the attack lands, and does not benefit from Spear of Shojin's damage amp.
mechanics.quote: The cone does not benefit from {{iis|Spear of Shojin}} damage amp.

mechanics.claim: Thunderclap deals increased (180%) damage against monsters, which does not apply in a champion-dummy fight.
The empowered attack cannot have its windup canceled by new movement or attack commands, or by casting Unstoppable Force.
mechanics.quote: ''Cannot'' have its {{tip|attack windup|windup}} canceled by new movement or attack commands, or casting {{ai|Unstoppable Force|Malphite}}.

mechanics.claim: The passive bonus armor is tripled while Granite Shield is active, which reduces damage taken rather than dealt.
mechanics.quote: '''Malphite''' gains {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}}, tripled while ''{{ai|Granite Shield|Malphite}}'' is active.
